intent.culture: Afro-diasporic and electronic club-groove conventions (explicit assumption)
prohibitions: no random swing on every note

narrative.description: initial affect established by multiple parameters
kick and muted pluck introduce the grid
syncopated bass enters on the off-grid cells
pad and counter line widen the image
drums and bass drop out; only the motif remains
all layers return, then hats open
low end and pad are removed before the final cell

sections.name: Intro
sections.description: kick and muted pluck establish the grid

sections.name: Groove A
sections.description: syncopated bass enters; the hook is repeated with a changed ending

sections.name: Break
sections.description: drums and bass drop; only the cell and pad remain

sections.name: Groove B
sections.description: bass displaces the hook; pad opens the image

sections.name: Peak
sections.description: all layers return; open hats and counter line lift the last pass

sections.name: Outro
sections.description: low end and pad leave before the final cell; no fake fade

motifs.name: Off-grid spark
motifs.description: Syncopated 16th-cell with a repeated note; designed for displacement, not constant new material.
